title: George Washington School reports 104 white students enrolled for 2025-26
text:
George Washington School registered 104 white students for the 2025-26 school year, reflecting a 1% uptick compared with the prior year, according to the New York State Education Department .
Among the 588 students enrolled during the 2025-26 school year, 17.7% identified as white, making this group the school’s second highest represented ethnicity.
The school operates in the White Plains City School District, which has its central office in White Plains.
White Plains Senior High School, one of seven schools in the district, recorded the largest white student enrollment at the time with 415 students.
New York ranks second nationwide in K-12 public education spending , reporting current expenditures of $30,012 per student—almost double the $16,526 national average—according to the Education Data Initiative.
